slides.texte_overlay:
The night routine of men
who wake up ready

1. Lay out tomorrow's clothes

One decision gone
before the day starts.

2. Phone charges
outside the bedroom

The last scroll steals
the first hour.

3. Write tomorrow's top 3

On paper. Wake up knowing.

4. Ten pages of a book

End the day with
something that lasts.

5. Clean kitchen before bed

Morning you starts
with a clean slate.

6. Same lights-out time

Even on Fridays.
Consistency beats intensity.

7. Learn one thing
before you sleep

Five minutes.
Wake up a little sharper.
slides.texte_sophia:
7. Learn one thing
before you sleep

Use a micro-learning app
like the Sophia app.
Wake up a little sharper.
